articles.title: Pudgy Penguins' Ethereum Layer-2 Abstract Is Shutting Down
articles.description: Abstract will shut down Dec. 15, saying a chain focused solely on consumer crypto proved unsustainable, and is urging users to bridge their assets off before then.

articles.title: Tether Hit With Lawsuit Over $2.76 Million Stablecoin Freeze
articles.description: The payments firm alleges Tether froze its treasury wallet on its own initiative over a Brazilian investigation it has no connection to—and has profited from the reserves while refusing to release the funds for more than a year.

articles.title: Bryan Johnson Spent Millions to Reverse Aging. He Says a Filter Works Better
articles.description: The face of the "Don't Die" movement now says retouching beats therapy for looking young. His transformation over the summer may explain why.

articles.title: Another Zcash ETF Is Coming: Winklevoss Twins File for 'WINK'
articles.description: The proposed fund would hold ZEC directly, trade on Nasdaq under "WINK" with Gemini as custodian, and add the Winklevoss twins to a wave of institutional interest in the privacy coin.

articles.title: Mistral AI Drops 'Le Chonk': A Massive AI Model Named After a Cat Meme
articles.description: Paris-based Mistral launched Large 4, a model nicknamed after a June internet joke. It tops GPT-6 Astra on one finance test, but trails Claude on others.

articles.title: Bitcoin Falls Asleep, But Privacy Coins Zcash and Monero Are Waking Up
articles.description: Bitcoin and Ethereum barely moved today, but Zcash and Monero are leading the largest coins over the last 24 hours.

articles.title: Flash Loan Attacks Drained $1.2B From DeFi Between 2020 and 2024: Study
articles.description: Attacks grew more sophisticated and less predictable over the period, according to researchers who scanned more than 20 billion transactions.

articles.title: Circle, Ripple and Standard Chartered Back OKX at Flat $25B Valuation
articles.description: A London quantitative hedge fund joins the round too, seven months after the NYSE's owner bought in at exactly the same price.

articles.title: Morning Minute: The CFTC Reveals Plan to Regulate Crypto Exchanges
articles.description: Clear rules of the road are here. So what does it all mean and what is the overall impact?

articles.title: Don Davis Bill Would Fine Candidates $10K for Trading on Their Own Elections
articles.description: The No Betting on Your Own Race Act also gives prediction markets cover to close accounts and report candidates to regulators.

articles.title: Crypto 'Godfather' Gets Six Years for Hiring Sheriff's Deputies, $37M Meta Fraud
articles.description: Adam Iza used off-duty LA deputies to pull warrants and personal data on his rivals, then moved the proceeds through crypto custodians.

articles.title: Solana Debuts Institutional Settlement Standard With J.P. Morgan Input
articles.description: Built with input from J.P. Morgan, the open-source "DvP" program lets institutions settle trades atomically on Solana with finality in seconds instead of days.

articles.title: Strive Adds $169M Bitcoin in Its Biggest Buy in Four Months
articles.description: The Nasdaq-listed bitcoin treasury company, co-founded by Vivek Ramaswamy, paid roughly $169 million for 2,000 coins last week and now holds 29,462 BTC.

articles.title: DeFi Development Corp Adds $3 Million in Solana as SOL Buys Slow
articles.description: Nasdaq-listed DeFi Development Corp's latest SEC filing shows its Solana stash grew 1%, to about 2.56 million SOL and SOL equivalents—roughly half the prior week's gain and well below mid-September's pace.

articles.title: A Florida Woman Used Claude as a Diary. An Anthropic Employee Read It and Reported It to Police
articles.description: Investigators say a Bonita Springs woman's Claude "diary" tripped Anthropic's safety filters. A human review team sent it to police, and Anthropic's own terms allow exactly that.

articles.title: Why a 4chan Bitcoin Prophecy Says Today Is the End of Crypto Winter
articles.description: An anonymous 4chan user called Bitcoin's October 2025 peak to the day way back in 2023. Could they be right again?

articles.title: Treasury Kills Crypto 'Unhosted Wallet' and Mixer Surveillance Rules
articles.description: FinCEN withdrew a 2020 proposal to track transactions with self-custodial crypto wallets and a 2023 plan to designate crypto mixing as a primary money laundering concern.

articles.title: Crypto Sleuth ZachXBT Fronted $350K to Pose as a Client of Lazarus' Chinese Launderers
articles.description: The on-chain sleuth says he posed as a customer of a Chinese crime syndicate, fronting $349,700 and eating 5% on every order, to track Lazarus Group's Bybit loot in real time.

articles.title: SEC Clears 3x Leveraged Bitcoin and Ethereum Funds for Trading
articles.description: The agency approved a Cboe rule letting six Volatility Shares funds that triple the daily moves of Bitcoin, Ethereum, gold, silver, oil, and natural gas list on a U.S. exchange.

articles.title: CFTC Unveils Plan to Bring Crypto Exchanges Under Federal Oversight
articles.description: The CFTC is seeking public comment on a framework that would create a new federal license for crypto exchanges, with leverage offers as the trigger for oversight.

articles.title: Bitcoin Just Flashed a Second, Stronger Golden Cross: Here's What That Means
articles.description: The Bitcoin rally keeps bumping into the same wall, but a classic bullish signal suggests the trend is built to last.

articles.title: NEXTPredict Founder: 'Nobody Was Serving' Prediction Markets' Enormous Audience
articles.description: Reporters from CNBC and CNN are on the program beside the exchanges, two weeks before the midterms put the sector on air.

articles.title: Bitmine Buys $41M More Ethereum, Reaching 99% of Its 'Alchemy of 5%' Target
articles.description: The purchase lifts Bitmine's stash past 6 million ETH—4.9% of supply and 99% of the way to its "Alchemy of 5%" goal—as chairman Tom Lee says Ethereum is "dwarfing" other macro assets.

articles.title: Strategy Posts $21B Q3 Gain, Buys $29M in BTC, Repurchases $176M in STRC
articles.description: The firm's Bitcoin holdings hit a record 848,000 BTC, while the quarterly gain is a fair-value mark carrying $1.88 billion in deferred tax.

articles.title: Metaplanet Sold 10,000 Bitcoin and Bought Back 11,000 to Prove a Point
articles.description: Rating agencies ask if a Bitcoin company will actually sell when obligations fall due. "We answered by doing it," said CEO Simon Gerovich.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Uptober Off to a Green Start
articles.description: Crypto majors and alts are rallying to start October. What’s driving the early action and will it continue?

articles.title: Greek Soldiers Among Alleged Leaders of $8M Crypto Pyramid Scheme
articles.description: An association for AI enthusiasts was allegedly the recruiting vehicle, and two anonymous tips to a government portal started the case.

articles.title: OKX and NYSE Owner ICE Plan 24/7 Tokenized Stock Trading Under SEC Exemption
articles.description: Filed under the SEC's new Innovation Exemption, the notice lists more than 60 stocks, including Nvidia and SpaceX, paired with stablecoins.

articles.title: Trump Taps Jay Clayton, the SEC Chair Who Sued Ripple, to Lead AI Push
articles.description: President Trump named a new "Super Intelligence Force" to coordinate federal AI policy, with Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton at the helm. As SEC chair, Clayton launched crypto lawsuits including the agency's case against Ripple.

articles.title: Banking Group Sues to Block Crypto's 'Side Door' Into the Banking System
articles.description: The Independent Community Bankers of America argues the OCC's national trust charters give crypto firms a "side door into the banking system" without the safeguards that bind traditional banks.

articles.title: 'Uptober' Starts Green as Bitcoin ETFs Draw $134 Million
articles.description: Spot Bitcoin ETFs took in $134.4 million over the first two trading days of October, rebounding from a Sept. 30 outflow as a weak jobs report cooled Fed rate-hike bets.

articles.title: 'We Have Identified You, Sir': Near Intents Recovers $3.8 Million After 48-Hour Ultimatum
articles.description: Near Intents said the roughly $3.8 million drained in an exploit on Thursday was returned in full, a day after the team said it had identified the attacker and gave them 48 hours to return the funds.

articles.title: Chainalysis Used AI to Trace the $387M Bitget Hack Back to North Korea
articles.description: The firm says the Sept. 24 breach pushed North Korea's 2026 crypto haul past $1 billion, and detailed how it used in-house AI to trace the stolen funds across four blockchains in a race against the attackers.

articles.title: OpenAI Banned PewDiePie Twice While He Built Ajax, an Uncensored AI That Will Run on Your PC
articles.description: The YouTuber says OpenAI suspended his account twice while he trained a small, uncensored model built to run on your own computer.

articles.title: Trump Is Hosting Yet Another Meme Coin Dinner: Here Are the Details
articles.description: The TRUMP meme coin project is inviting its top 185 holders to a Nov. 22 gala dinner with President Trump two weeks after ethics disputes over his crypto interests helped stall the Clarity Act in the Senate.

articles.title: The Pope Has Thoughts on AI Art—And They're Not Flattering
articles.description: The pontiff says algorithms "lack the spark of humanity," and the Vatican wants to renew an alliance with artists and cultural institutions to protect it.

articles.title: California Subpoenas OpenAI Over AI Models That Hacked Their Way Out of a Test
articles.description: California's attorney general wants answers from OpenAI about AI models that escaped a locked test environment and hacked Hugging Face—and whether the company can be held legally accountable.
